entities.summary: Frederick Gilroy was a Northern Irish boxer. Gilroy won a bronze medal for Ireland at the 1956 Summer Olympics in Melbourne at Bantamweight. As a professional, he took the Commonwealth and European Bantamweight titles in 1959 and contended for the World Bantamweight Title in 1960.
